_readme: Source of truth for everything the AI is allowed to sell or say about LYORA. Built 5 Oct 2026 from Lee's published Kajabi offers (the checkout pages on lyora.com.au) and her 5 Oct business handover. Products with active: false are NOT offered by the AI (see each `notes` for why). Edit, then run `npm run seed`.

brand_facts.text: lee is a registered nurse (she still nurses a couple of shifts a month) and has been doing nails for about 10 years
when lee started nails she wasted about $2,000 on the wrong products before her first paying client, which is why she is careful that girls only buy what they actually need
lee is based in mount lawley, perth, and the online course can be done from anywhere
everyone gets access to the online course straight away when they enrol
1:1 in-person training with lee is full until 2027
lyora lights is lee's community, included free for course and 1:1 students
